rank_correlation.note: agreement vs unsafe (binary 0/1); negative => higher agreement, fewer unsafe moves. EXPLORATORY ONLY: these p-values are crude normal approximations with heavy ties and are NOT used for inference; the bootstrap delta-CI on AURC is the inferential test.

tie_diagnostic.note: agreement_correctset uses ground truth (correct_moves) and is a DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not a deployable signal).

self_report_baseline.note: self-reported confidence is saturated; its AURC equals the constant-confidence baseline (mean loss). Self-consistency AURC must beat these baselines to add value.
